status: Explicit hardware loading interface implemented; real CPU SoC regression pending
boundary: New explicit external ICB input, not claimed to be an organizer-approved existing top-level port
ownership: Round-robin qingyu_icb_merge NP3 OUTSTANDING4 MASK000, in-order bounded owner FIFO; no CPU replacement or stolen response
request: CPU writes real MMIO mailbox0xf0020000:+4epoch,+8chunk1..9; request valid/ready/epoch/chunk exposed at top; successful MMIO enqueue is not data completion
completion: BFM only writes READY_SEQ after every source prefix and preceding control word receives its real shared/SystemBus response; CPU reads actual shared READY and then sends accelerator commit
BFM_role: File read and once-only packet parsing outside timing; external request handshake plus real independent ICB commands/responses only. No private CPU signal observation or hardware-source substitution.

timing.start: Earliest task mailbox or shared control offer, loader request offer, or actual loader write offer
timing.end: Final actual output marker response ACK
timing.includes: new MMIO request latency, loader/shared control writes, CPU polls, arbitration, stalls and output writes
timing.excludes: firmware/poison initialization and boot before the first task control offer; post-task output inspection

area_power_accounting: 3rd source command mux and enlarged owner queue
new real MMIO mailbox and FIO response route
all new clocked/request signals; no baseline area/power reuse
official_scope: Guide requires platform interfaces and real transport but does not mandate serial package pins. Exposing a new ICB master does not itself prove permitted existing-interface status. Original ext2dtcm+CPU-copy remains a separate sensitivity option.
forbidden_shortcuts: no unmodeled source bus master excluded from PPA
